svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Number of clinical trials by purpose
Annual number of completed clinical trials registered globally in the ClinicalTrials.gov database, by purpose. The
purpose of a clinical trial refers to the main objective or goal of the study, such as testing a new treatment,
comparing treatments, or understanding a disease. This includes only interventional trials.

tspan.tspan: ClinicalTrials.gov was established in 2000 and data on trials starting before that is incomplete. There can also be a delay in registration,

text.tspan: so latest years might not have complete data yet.
